display_long_description:
Tiny Trouble VR is a VR flying adventure built around the fantasy of becoming one with a bird. Instead of simply controlling a vehicle, you feel as if you are standing on the bird's back, sharing its movement, speed, and instinct as you race through open skies.

In this demo, the core experience focuses on flight and aerial racing. Players guide their bird through the air, learn its rhythm, and enjoy the physical sense of soaring, turning, diving, and accelerating in VR. The goal is to make flying feel natural, exciting, and personal.

The project is designed to grow beyond racing. Future updates are planned to introduce exploration and combat modes, where the bird is not only a mount but also a companion. Players may travel through beautiful environments, discover scenic routes, and face enemies together with their bird partner.

Tiny Trouble VR is for players who want to feel the freedom of flight, the intensity of competition, and the bond between rider and creature in a VR world.
This game requires Hand Tracking to be enabled on the device. On Meta Quest 3S / Quest 3, users can enable it by going to Settings → Movement Tracking and turning on "Hand & Body Tracking".
